node.name: footer · data statement
node.chars: Data: synthetic only (spec L68: a seeded synthetic BTCUSDT profile declared on each board): BTCUSDT 30-minute bars seeded 416, 10 Oct – 31 Oct 2026 14:30 UTC; tick size 0.10 from the recorded instrument fixture. No account, key, balance, order or environment on any frame (R-1, C-2.11: no DEMO / LIVE badge, no environment control, no account context)

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: Fidelity: greyscale wireframe, desktop, 1280 × 800 windows (§0 L68); wire tokens only (§2 L126): color.surface.canvas, color.surface.raised, color.surface.overlay, color.border.default, color.text.primary, color.text.secondary, color.text.tertiary; type.ui.caption, type.ui.label, type.num.sm. Theme dark (0 light twins, §0); hi-fi is E19-D03's

kids.name: value-4
kids.chars: R-1 (C-2.11, L97): the panel is environment-neutral; no DEMO / LIVE badge, no environment control and no account context on any frame

kids.name: value-5
kids.chars: Not drawn — the text is binding (§0 L83): SCR-038/load-failed, SCR-038/stale, SCR-039/comfortable, SCR-038/tpo-detail

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: Session 30 Oct, linear; W-2 'Aligned to BTCUSDT · 30m' (the alignment status, a menu button named by its text + ', change chart')

kids.name: value-6
kids.chars: Each boundary price goes through the bound chart's own price -> y of the same frame (`26`:216–221); never a separate scale, never an interpolated copy (§4.1 rule 2)

value-2.chars: Composite of the 21 complete sessions (10 Oct – 30 Oct), row size 2000 ticks (kit choice); the chart in log mode, 4-hour candles

value-5.chars: Top / bottom row height ratio 0.922 = the log mapping's (`26`:221)

value-2.chars: Two frames of one auto-fit side by side (§4.3 'two stacked frames', laid out left to right so each keeps the full window height, kit choice), both aligned: the panel reads the priceLow / priceHigh of the frame being drawn (auto-scale at most once per frame, `26`:228; sync once per frame, `26`:229); never the animation's end state, never a frame late (§4.1 rule 4)

value-3.chars: frame 1: priceLow 62,650.1, priceHigh 65,744.9 (the range 40 % wider than its end state each side, kit choice); POC row at y 435.6 px, h 2.20 px

value-4.chars: frame 2: priceLow 62,948.9, priceHigh 65,356.0 (the range 20 % wider than its end state each side, kit choice); POC row at y 429.7 px, h 2.82 px

value-5.chars: Each half is a 640 × 800 window (the chart narrower; the panel 280 px); motion choreography is E19-D05's

kids.name: value-2
kids.chars: The bound chart in percent mode (`15`:2426): the panel draws its own CMP-188 on its left edge and the header says W-3 'Own price scale — not aligned' (§4.1 rule 6); it never shows a misaligned histogram beside a chart

kids.name: value-3
kids.chars: Also W-3 when the chart shows another symbol, is inverted, closed or hidden, or is log with a price <= 0 in range (`26`:772) — not drawn separately, the text is binding

kids.name: value-4
kids.chars: W-3 announced once, polite, when alignment is lost; W-2 once when regained; a flapping condition coalesced to the latest state (R-4)
